title: Ember: An Extensible Benchmark Suite for Quantum Annealing Embedding Algorithms
summary: Minor embedding is a required compilation step for quantum annealing, mapping logical problem graphs onto sparse hardware topologies. Despite its central role in determining solution quality, no standardized benchmark exists for comparing embedding algorithms: prior studies use incompatible graph libraries, inconsistent metrics, and non-reproducible experimental setups, making cross-algorithm comparisons unreliable. We present Ember (Embedding Minor Benchmark for Evaluative Reproducibility), an open-source benchmarking framework addressing this gap. Ember provides a standardized algorithm…
